Messages.Author: Ben Peal
Messages.Body:
.

Heya! It's that time of year again!

For the third year in a row, the Northeast Regional Qualifier will be
held at TotalCon, in Mansfield, MA. TotalCon itself runs from Thursday,
February 19 through Sunday, February 22. V:TES events will be as
follows:

Friday, February 20
Bloodwork
Standard Constructed Tournament
7pm - 1am (using the 7pm-11pm slot)
2 rounds plus finals

Saturday, February 21
2004 Northeast Regional Qualifier
Standard Constructed Tournament
1pm - 11pm
3 rounds plus finals

Sunday, February 22
2004 Winter Storyline Event
(format to be announced)
10am - 5pm
(again, format to be announced)

The top 10 not-yet-qualified players at the Qualifier will qualify
to attend all V:EKN Championship Events, including the North American
Championship at GenCon in Indianapolis, and the European Championship
in Germany.

V:EKN Tournament Rules:
www.white-wolf.com/vtes/veknRules.html

V:EKN Championship website (please update this soon, WW):
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Championship.html

All I know about the upcoming Storyline is that it will be a league
format. That's _all_ I know, and more information will be announced
by White Wolf soon. I've just got the slot reserved for whatever
event we need for it at the con. :)

Information about TotalCon:

Website (please oh please let them update the events page):
www.totalcon.com

TotalCon will be held at:
Holiday Inn Mansfield
31 Hampshire Street
Mansfield, MA
(508) 339-2200

I don't know what the hotel rates are, but make sure you mention
that you're there for TotalCon in case there's a discount. :)

TotalCon pricing:
We've managed to get a $35 weekend pass for TotalCon if you're
only going to be playing V:TES events. Note that you _must_
pre-register in order to get the V:TES pass. (It's called
the V:TES Pass in the website.) Also note that if you pre-register
for the standard $30 weekend ticket (not the V:TES Pass), you'll
have to pay event fees on top of that weekend ticket, which will
bump the cost to $42.50 or something. At any rate, one-day tickets
are $10 if you pre-register, or $12.50 at the door.

Remember: You MUST pre-register in order to get the $35 V:TES Pass.

That's all I can think of for now. If you have any questions or
comments, email me at fu...@mindstorm.com.

I look forward to seeing you there!

- Ben Peal, Prince of Boston
fu...@mindstorm.com

As far as I'm concerned, this can't be done soon enough. This is
the third year in a row that I'll be running the Northeast Regional
Qualifier in February, and it's the third year in a row that White
Wolf won't have the new Championship page ready for the start of
the new season.

By the by, the details for the Northeast Regional Qualifier were
finalized and approved by White Wolf a month ago. I waited until
now to announce the qualifier because TotalCon wanted to finalize
the weekend V:TES Pass and some things for their website first.
At any rate, I really don't see how it would have been so difficult
for White Wolf to put up at least a temporary 2004 Championship page
listing the Qualifiers they did know about and approve so that there
could be at least some advertisement on the White Wolf site for these
events before they happen.

Oh, and the Northeast Regional Qualifier won't be the first one
of the season - that'll be the Mid Atlantic Qualifier held in
New Jersey on January 24.
